policy.purpose: Curated external motion assets may enrich production but never override the active Design System or factual QA.
rules: Reference marketplaces and galleries for discovery only until the specific asset license is recorded.
Do not copy, scrape or redistribute a third-party asset merely because it is publicly viewable.
Prefer first-party recreation or a licensed local file for production.
Record whether colors can be adapted safely; never recolor protected official marks inside a motion asset.
Reject assets whose expressions or effects render non-deterministically in the target runtime.
Use preview or review status until a smoke render passes.
